grant_capability.detail: The evolution layer proposed this from measured evidence, but a system that can widen its own permissions has no meaningful limit. Promotion is the deliberate boundary: it stays inert until you accept it.
grant_capability.headline: Only you may grant the loop new capability

gui_only.detail: The setting lives behind a GUI or a per-application profile. Editing the underlying store directly is undocumented and version-specific, so scripting it risks corrupting the application's configuration.
gui_only.headline: No safe scriptable equivalent

needs_elevation.detail: The dashboard service runs unprivileged on purpose — a telemetry process that can elevate is a far larger risk than the problem it fixes. There is no way for it to acquire admin rights without a UAC prompt only you can answer.
needs_elevation.headline: Needs administrator rights

needs_judgement.detail: Which items are essential is specific to how you work. The loop has no way to tell a critical tool from an unnecessary one, and guessing wrong breaks something you depend on. It is left manual deliberately.
needs_judgement.headline: Requires knowing what matters to you

no_evidence.detail: The recipe needs a parameter the loop has no measurement for, and inventing a plausible value is worse than leaving it blank. Supply the value, or wait for the evidence to accumulate.
no_evidence.headline: Missing a value nothing has measured

persistent_config.detail: This is not a transient tweak: it rewrites persistent machine configuration. You should know it happened, because it keeps applying long after the shortfall that prompted it has gone.
persistent_config.headline: Changes configuration that survives reboot

session_killing.detail: The action restarts the WSL VM, which hosts the dashboard, its collector and the sampling history. Run automatically it would kill the process mid-cycle and lose the measurement it was trying to make.
session_killing.headline: Would terminate this dashboard
